title: Bohr radius of the bidisc K_2, upper bound
statement: Give a 3 x 3 unitary colligation U = Ut/den with Gaussian-integer entries Ut (blocks of sizes 1 and 2), a degree N and r = R/E such that the Bohr sum of the transfer function f = A + B Delta (I - D Delta)^-1 C up to degree N in each variable exceeds 1 at r. Unitarity makes f a Schur function, so K_2 < r. Smaller r is better.
submission: JSON: {"den": integer, "U": 3 x 3 list of [re, im] integer pairs (the numerators Ut), "N": integer, "r": [R, E], "n": 1, "m": 1}, as in gomyway's c59 certificate.
